mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of over 10% signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < previous year -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for four consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing output and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month -0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% interacts with a concurrent decline in real personal income (PAYEMS) to signal a restrictive monetary stance coincident with weakening income, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with income weakness
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) of more than 1% for four consecutive months signals deteriorating consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.4 percentage points in one month, combined with a concurrent drop in payroll employment (PAYEMS), signals a sudden labor market shock, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.4pp AND PAYEMS falls YoY in same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline of more than 1% in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based contraction in supply-side activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in a non-recessionary regime.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month -1% AND HOUST < previous month -1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes outside of official recessions.
